body:
This module has interactive components, such as accordions, tabs, and hotspots, that must be completed before moving forward.

Selecting the progress bar at the top right of the screen will display all the interactive components within the chapter. Once the progress bar is filled, you can move on to the next chapter.
At the end of each chapter, answer the “Check Your Progress” questions to complete the chapter.
Glossary terms are highlighted throughout this module. The glossary can also be accessed by selecting the menu on the right.
Select the Quick Fact! and Zoom In icons at the margins to display callouts with additional information.

body: Welcome to the base sample module. This module is not about a product: it exists so that every component the automation can build appears once, with real copy around it. Use it to see what a component looks like before authoring your own storyboard.

_notifyAnywhere.title: base sample module
_notifyAnywhere.body: the course in base/Source: one sample of every component the automation can build

body:
This module is arranged as a course, not as a catalogue:

  • Chapter 1 covers the content components: copy, lists, tables, figures and callouts.
  • Chapter 2 covers the interactivities: accordions, tabs, hot spots, carousels, popups and sliders.
  • Each chapter ends with Key Concepts and a set of Check Your Progress questions, as a real module does.

Upon completion of this module, learners will be able to:

  • Recognise every component the automation builds.
  • Author a storyboard that asks for each of them.
  • Tell the conventions that carry meaning from those that do not.

_items.body:

body: Select each panel below to open it.

_items.title: One Panel at a Time
_items.body: An accordion opens one panel at a time and suits a list of topics that are read in any order.

_items.title: A Panel With a Figure
_items.body:
A figure inside a panel stays where the author put it, above its caption.

Figure 2-1: A Figure Inside an Accordion Panel

_items.title: A Panel With Bullets
_items.body:
• Panels carry bullets as well as paragraphs.
  • Each panel is one item of the component.

body: Tabs suit a small number of parallel topics.

title: Horizontal Tabs
_comment: Only set min height if you want to uniform the content container size across tab items. By default, the container will display at the height of each item's content

_items.body: Horizontal tabs sit in a row above their copy.
Use them where the titles are short and the panels are of similar length.

title: Vertical Tabs
_comment: Only set min height if you want to uniform the content container size across tab items. By default, the container will display at the height of each item's content

_items.body: Vertical tabs stack down the left, which suits longer titles.
A product's Indication, Administration and Safety are often authored this way.
Each tab holds one topic, so the learner can compare them.
